2. A village sports club organises a women’s football tournament. The club earned money by selling match tickets and charging fees for team participation. They sold 57 tickets for ₹115 each. They had 3 teams joining the tournament, with each team paying a participation fee of ₹1,599. The teams paid ₹1,750 in total to rent the football ground and ₹1,129 for food and water. (a) How much money did the club collect in total from ticket sales and team participation fees? (b) What were the total expenses on renting the ground and food and water?
